identification: Boxed Parker Sonnet fountain pen with a chevron (herringbone) engraved pattern on cap and barrel, gold-tone clip, cap band and grip section, rhodium-silver nib with engraved scroll, modern grey Sonnet box ('Sonnet, a timeless symbol of elegance... Google check: chevron/'Mediterranean wind' pattern with gold trim and gold grip is the Sonnet Premium Silver Mistral GT (sterling silver 925, 18k rhodium-plated nib), not the lattice-pattern Sonnet Sterling Cisele. Both are sterling; the plated/steel Sonnet has plain or lacquer finishes. Photos 1-2 viewed, zoomed on cap, band, clip and nib.
answers: {'question': "Sterling silver Cisele (hallmarked, 'STERLING' on cap) or plated/steel Mistral?", 'answer': "Pattern is chevron = Mistral, in the Premium Silver Mistral GT style, which Parker makes in solid sterling silver (925). No hallmark or 'STERLING' text is legible on the cap band or clip in the photos, so sterling is inferred from the pattern and finish, not read. Silver colour of the barrel looks right for sterling (matt silver, not brassy).
